completed_base_two_seed_validation64.interpretation: Both seeds learn useful predictive motion beyond persistence, but both remain geometrically worse than releasedPVB on new48 and all64. Neither shows a stable new48 or all64 COM/pocket whole-path advantage over PVB. Contact occupancy improves in both seeds; contact Brier has a negative CI only in seed72, so this is not a uniformly replicated contact benefit. No default promotion or claim that old16 results generalized as a joint win.
completed_base_two_seed_validation64.limitations: Development64, two training seeds, marginal paired-system intervals; no independent or equilibrium conclusion. Base71 includes a documented step4608 resume after a nonfinite event.

released_pvb_minus_observed_last_frame.interpretation: On new48, releasedPVB improves RMSF and whole COM/pocket path scores versus an observed-last-frame point mass, with negative marginal CIs. Its bond error is worse, and COM-MSD CI crosses zero. All64 COM-path CI crosses zero while pocket-path benefit persists. This is evidence that the expanded development set can measure useful predictive motion, not just static geometry, but not a universal or equilibrium success. Candidate models must be compared to the same point-mass baseline using completed matching128 conditions, not different subsets.
